newsitem.title: COMOROS: Two killed in Comoros fighting.
newsitem.headline: Two killed in Comoros fighting.

text.p: Two people were killed and several others wounded on the Comoros island of Anjouan on Monday in a clash between secessionists and security forces, witnesses said.
Government cars were burned in the clashes, which started after a large crowd attempted to hoist a French flag on Bastille Day, said the witnesses contacted by telephone.
Mahamoud Ahmed Abdallah, Secretary-General at the President's Office, ordered the national airline Aero Comoros' to put a plane at the disposition of the military to fly reinforcements to Anjouan.

Tension has been high on Anjouan after the arrest on Sunday of Charikane Ahmed, 65, a popular secessionist leader. Clashes between the army and residents last March caused several deaths and many arrests.

The Comoro Islands archipelego, with a population of 190,000, became independent from France in 1975 but some islanders appear to want to return to the French fold, saying independence has brought only poverty, corruption and political unrest.
